title: Pairing Response
description: Schema for POST /__remote_everything_pair response (public mode). Shared by Go, Kotlin, Swift, and ArkTS strict decoders.

ok.description: Always true for a valid pairing response.

certificate_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the issued client certificate.

credential_format.description: Credential encoding format. Only pkcs12 is supported.

credential_pkcs12.description: Base64-encoded PKCS#12 archive containing the client certificate and private key.

pending_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant when the pending authorization expires.
